• ANAD is a nonprofit providing free support services, including a helpline, recovery 
mentorship, and support groups, to anyone struggling with an eating disorder, disordered 
eating, and body image. 
• Project HEAL is a nonprofit that offers free, 1-hour phone assessments for eating disorders, 
as well as free and sliding scale treatment, with a focus on increasing access for people 
identifying as BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and from other marginalized communities.
